description: Scan a single company career board across 10 ATS platforms (workday, greenhouse, lever, ashby, personio, teamtailor, smartrecruiters, workable, recruitee, pinpoint) via career URL (`url`) or (`platform` + `target`) to extract open jobs, 125+ tech-stack signals, disclosed salaries, and B2B buying intent scores.

platform.description: ATS platform identifier (defaults to auto when url is passed).

target.description: Company ATS board slug or career URL (e.g. nvidia, salesforce, figma, zoox, ramp, adsquare, puzzel, viva, channable, smartthings, Canva).

url.description: Full career board URL (auto-detects *.myworkdayjobs.com/*, *.myworkdaysite.com/*, boards.greenhouse.io/*, job-boards.greenhouse.io/*, jobs.lever.co/*, jobs.ashbyhq.com/*, *.jobs.personio.de/*, *.teamtailor.com/*, careers.smartrecruiters.com/*, apply.workable.com/*, *.recruitee.com/*, *.pinpointhq.com/*).

name: scan_company_hiring_intent
